# `factory/sdk/ui/controls.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/factory/sdk/ui/controls.js`

sdk/ui/controls.js — atomic interactive controls. Each returns a DOM node wired to the shared stylesheet (.fx-*). Behaviour is headless-ish: state lives in the caller, controls expose value/onChange. No app reimplements buttons, inputs, toggles, etc.
